title: Chinese J-16 fighters arrive in Egypt ahead of Eagles of Civilisation 2026 joint drill

article.title: Chinese J-16 fighters arrive in Egypt ahead of Eagles of Civilisation 2026 joint drill
article.summary: A fleet of Chinese J-16 fighters has arrived in Egypt ahead of a joint exercise that will be the aircraft’s first-ever deployment to Africa. The planes and aviators taking part in the Eagles of Civilisation 2026 exercise arrived at an Egyptian airbase on Friday morning after a 6,000km (3,700-mile) journey that took nine hours and required the planes to refuel in mid-air, according to the People’s Liberation Army.
